verdict.rationale: Scheduling workflows is a fair question for a workflow-automation product, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a schedule trigger, cron expressions, or timezone settings. The closest items are adjacent: 'polling triggers' for integration developers and an AI meeting-scheduling feature, neither of which is recurring workflow scheduling. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control
